caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #29: ABROGATE

abrogate (verb): to officially cancel or repeal a law or agreement.

✅ In a sentence: The new government moved to abrogate the trade treaty its predecessor had signed.
✅ Similar: repeal, revoke, annul
✅ Remember it: Usually done by an authority to laws, treaties, or rights.
